offering_description.value: DMC Global makes architectural framing, windows and doors for commercial and high-end residential construction. It manufactures well perforating systems for oilfield service companies and explosion-bonded metal plates and joints for industrial equipment fabricators.

primary_products.value: Storefront and curtain wall systems; architectural windows and doors; well perforating systems; shaped charges and detonators; clad metal plates and transition joints

customer_segment.value: B2B: Glazing contractors, window and door dealers, oilfield service companies, and industrial equipment fabricators

end_markets.value: Commercial construction; high-end residential construction; oil and gas; chemical processing; shipbuilding

revenue_model.value: product sales: Architectural systems, well perforating equipment and consumables, and custom clad metal products

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns metal stock and components into building systems, perforating equipment, and clad metals for contractors, oilfield firms, and fabricators

geography_served.value: global: Architectural sales concentrated in the United States, with oilfield and clad metal sales across North America, Europe, and other regions

specialization.value: diversified: Architectural building systems, oilfield perforating equipment, and explosion-bonded metals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving glazing contractors, oilfield service companies, and industrial fabricators; distributors / dealers: Specialty window and door dealers serving residential construction

regulatory_exposure.value: high: ATF licensing for explosives manufacturing and distribution, DOT hazardous materials transport rules, and building codes for architectural products

notes: The profile includes the architectural products business based on DMC Global’s last-known controlling interest.
